messages:
maya: Hey team — quick coordination ask. PR ready that touches runtime batch routing + infra KMS logic. Need reviewers from runtime, infra, and security before I can schedule a staging cutover. Can folks volunteer or point me to owners?

oliver: pinged runtime and infra owners in the channel. can you drop the PR link and short risk summary?

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/18274 — summary: changes to routing policy (+ fallback model variant), batching config default tweak, and a new call into infra/kms to rotate keys for cached payload encryption. Risk: potential latency regression on hot path and about 1s added to cold-starts when kms is reachable. Added feature flag and canary rollout.

jen: I can take infra review. Quick Q: does the KMS call happen on the hot path or is it async? if it's sync we need a circuit breaker.

srinivas: i'll look at runtime side. is there a perf bench or a short perf test I can run? also want to validate KV cache handling for model variants.

maya: KMS call is sync during first-decrypt only; we added local caching of decrypted key for 10m. feature flag defaults to off for hosted. Perf bench: //bench/perf/routing_hotpath.py — I ran 3k iters, ~0.8% p99 increase locally. I'll kick off the perf job with the PR sha if you want.

kevin: security here. I'll need: 1) short threat model (one paragraph), 2) proof KMS principal is least-priv, 3) audit log entries enabled for rotate ops. Can you attach those to the PR?

maya: copying the requested artifacts into the PR now: - THREAT_MODEL.md (one paragraph) - infra/iam/kms-principal-policy.md - tests/rotate_audit_test.sh added to e2e.

ci-bot: CI passed — unit: ✅, integration: ✅, e2e: running (3/5 shards passed).

jen: okay i can pick infra approval after e2e green. need at least one canary host in staging for 2h.

srinivas: i ran the perf job on sha 6f3a2b — attached results to PR comments. looks fine for 95% of trace shapes but a regression on long-seq synthetic. i'll add a fallback path to skip key-resolve when seq>2048.

maya: that fallback change sounds good — can you open a tiny follow-up pr or i can add it here if you prefer?

srinivas: i'll open a follow-up and link it.

kevin: will review after the artifacts are in and e2e flakes are resolved. tentatively available for approval this afternoon.

oliver: scheduling note: we have a staging cutover window tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT. if you want the slot, please confirm reviewers + canary owner by EOD so SRE can reserve.

maya: confirmed reviewers: @jen (infra), @srinivas (runtime), @kevin (sec). canary owner: @jen. aiming for the 10:00 PT slot. assigning reviewers in PR now. thanks all :pray:

jen: :thumbsup: i'll own the canary and monitor traces during cutover.

ci-bot: e2e finished — all shards passed.

oliver: sg, i'll block the cutover slot with SRE and update the runbook.

maya: great — i'll mark feature flag off by default and push final merge plan. thanks everyone.
